issue.title: Enhancement: LACP fast rate based for `add-topo` and `deploy-mg` based on additional params

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Critical

### Description of the enhancement

We want to be able to enable LACP fast rate on the DUT side (via `deploy-mg`) and the neighbors side (via `add-topo`).

We want to do this based on additional params via ansible `-e lacp_fast_rate=True` (or false), e.g.:
`sudo ./testbed-cli.sh redeploy-topo dut password.txt -e lacp_fast_rate=true`
`sudo ./testbed-cli.sh deploy-mg dut inv_file password.txt -e lacp_fast_rate=true`

### Current Behavior

No such option exists at the moment.

### Proposed Behavior

As description.
